Data.subject: Manufacturing
Data.title: Principal Statistics Of Manufacturing, (Excluding Rubber Processing And Granite Quarrying), Annual
Data.footnote: From 2002, figures include data gathered from all manufacturing establishments.  Prior to 2002, data refer to establishments engaging 10 or more workers.  Valuation of output has been changed to basic price.  Historical manufacturing output, total output, operating cost, sales and direct exports have been revised accordingly from 1980.  The values of fixed assets are at end of year.  Year 2025 data are preliminary estimates.
